title: Mr. Hamada: a 3D model made the way Kuro, Aoi and Emi were
question: The first two sheets are ChatGPT pictures; every sheet after them is a render of the real rigged model, which you can turn in the live viewer next to Eric, Mio, Kuro, Aoi and Emi (link below). He is in the game now. Is Hamada right?

options.label: kuroda-1
options.note: The rigged model from e1 (chat a1, b1, c1, d1, then the head follow-up): smart topology, 1,050 polygons, our UV layout with the face in one piece, Meshy retexture styled from e1, auto-rig at 1.1 m, Meshy sit. Head share 0.40. In the game at 1.09 tall in place of his code-built body wherever he appears. 23 Meshy credits; six pictures $1.50.
